Keep all four learned-attention mean rows and existing projection matrices/bias.

change.variance_center: mu_u,j=0.5*sum(local_uniform_j*safe_h)+0.5*sum(global_uniform*safe_h), its OWN two-sum uniform mean; never center around the attention mean.
change.dispersion: v_j=sum_t u_jt*(safe_h_t-mu_u,j)^2 componentwise population second central moment.
change.rows: Keep each existing eight-row projection slice: first4 attention mean, last4 uniform centered variance; biases once, exact whole8 zero after bias for locally absent bins.
